blocking_prerequisites: Reviewed implementation and dependency versions must be frozen before execution.
A separate trusted intake for new targets is required; never bypass reference401/selected401 checks.
Original Wout and seed must be available at their exact hashes.
confirmatory_blockers: Common realized-flux and straight-field-line phase mapping is unqualified.
Wide actual-coil action domain has missing/extra wells; no valid common endpoint exists yet.

target_wout.availability: maintainer-local; regenerated bytes are not interchangeable

coil_seed.availability: local; exact copy in prepared issue53 archive 293d0a65601c8293c936617f720fcfe099b3a27f

fixed.all_other_input_fields: byte-equivalent JSON values; no resolution/tolerance changes
fixed.volume_definition: absolute full-torus integral of x dot (x_theta cross x_phi)/3; compare candidate to original at each grid
fixed.volume_grids_description: full-torus N theta by N phi midpoint grids; both angles in radians over [0,2*pi)

C.search: single existing coil fit from original seed

J.search: bounded plasma-coordinate poll with a coil fit at each target
J.proposal_order: as listed; all centered on original target, not adaptive
J.coil_start: original identical seed for each proposal; no warm starts from other arms

execution.clock_or_suspension_anomaly: stop; comparison incomplete; no budget reset
execution.common_setup_cost: charge separately in each arm; no uncharged generated target cache

optimization.plasma_objective: ideal-target mean action variance over the full registered 5x7 domain; lower is better
optimization.field_term: existing local SquaredFlux / area, minimized by the inner coil fit
optimization.candidate_selection: lowest complete ideal plasma score among nonzero proposals with an eligible inner-fit candidate; ties lower inner objective then proposal index
optimization.inner_candidate_selection: unchanged lowest boundary RMS with sampled geometry/current and length <=3.45m
optimization.missing_plasma_cells: proposal ineligible; retain every failure; no reduced-domain score
optimization.target_changes: rebuild boundary/normals, equilibrium and interior Cartesian target arrays per input hash; fixed flux and B2 scale
optimization.current_rule: existing scalar signed-flux normalization at each target; freeze chosen currents before checks
optimization.target_B2_reporting: report measured candidate B2 separately; never replace the fixed reference diagnostic normalization

diagnostics.holdout_scope: withheld phase grid only; not unseen target/seed generalization
diagnostics.target_launch_trace_scope: diagnostic only; no claim of matched realized flux/alpha
diagnostics.ideal_holdout_convergence_rule: abs(S1601-S3201) <= 0.001*max(abs(S1601),abs(S3201),1e-12), separately for C and J
diagnostics.maximum_normal_error: report both fine-grid maxima against unchanged 1e-3 acceptance gate; no acceptance from feasibility screens

common_physics_endpoint.statistic: mean normalized within-period action variance in actual frozen coil fields
common_physics_endpoint.required_before_confirmation: separate reviewed protocol freezing the qualified common flux/phase mapping, endpoint refinement, holdouts and error budget before new candidates

decision.feasibility_continue: both proposals terminate within search budget; at least one nonzero proposal passes size/intake; frozen selected pair completes all diagnostics, continuous geometry and current limits; J ideal holdout <=0.99*C ideal holdout at both refinements; J own-target fine boundary and interior RMS each <=1.10*C corresponding diagnostic; direct traces complete; holdout refinement passes
decision.change: both J proposals explicitly rejected without resource interruption, or complete selected pair fails feasibility screens; only this bounded basis/recipe is unsupported
decision.inconclusive: missing input or C candidate, unqualified implementation, resource/clock interruption, unfinished J proposal, or incomplete selected-pair diagnostics
decision.boundary_ratio_scope: own-target feasibility non-regression screen only, never a common physics gain
decision.after_continue: qualify common realized-field endpoint before confirmatory optimization; no automatic larger search
decision.numerical_rejection: retain documented nonconvergence/invalid geometry or complete plasma-domain failure; resource interruption is not a completed rejection

cost_rationale: Two equilibrium solves at the documented approximate six-minute regeneration scale plus two at-most-five-minute coil fits leave part of the30-minute search budget for intake/scoring. This is a planning estimate, not measured perturbed-target runtime; ceilings never increase.
